details.name: Modifying a List (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that increments all values of the list by 1.

details.name: Modifying a List (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that swaps pairs of adjacent elements of the list. For example, if the list is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], the program will change it to [2, 1, 4, 3, 6, 5].\nThis program assumes that the list has always an even number of elements.
